2609.40241.title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev
2609.40241.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.
2609.40241.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在推薦重排序方面顯示出潛力，但它們的使用引入了推薦質量與服務效率之間的重要權衡。<lb/>我們調查當重排序任務本質上是在預定候選項之間進行結構化選擇時，決策導向模型是否提供了一個有用的替代方案。<lb/>具體而言，我們對TypeSafe AI所描述的Jev進行了一項受控的實證研究，該模型被稱為“系統一模型”，用於個性化推薦重排序，並將其與推薦特定模型以及多個Amazon Reviews領域和候選集大小下的點對點和列表Qwen重排序器進行比較，評估推薦效果和觀察到的服務延遲。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，Jev在相對於評估基準的情況下保持了強大的推薦效果，同時其延遲增長的速度顯著慢於點對點的Qwen重排序器，儘管其觀察到的服務延遲仍然顯著高於推薦特定模型。<lb/>這些特徵使Jev在不同的候選大小和領域中處於一個獨特的質量-延遲運行範疇。<lb/>這些發現促使我們進一步研究決策導向模型在推薦和其他具有結構化輸出空間的排序任務中的應用。
